generatedProse.practice-connection: Across your studies, reflecting on experience is a habit that runs through placements, projects, practicals and any work you learn by doing. Each one asks you to look back at what you did, work out what it taught you, and act differently next time. Treat what follows as being about your own placements, projects and reflective logs, not about study in the abstract. The same habit carries into professional work, where looking back and acting on it is how people keep improving long after they graduate.
